I went down a rabbit hole of directly reading foreign travelers’ views of India over the centuries, prompted by watching Shashi Tharoor’s Empire videos. summary I walked away with: there is not much doubt that India was either the first or second richest country in the world throughout its history. foreigners from all parts of the old world visited India and consistently highlighted that India was richer than their own land. two centuries of colonialism undid that. We are now building our way back to the historic status, just a small part of the way back but moving in the right direction
i deliberately highlighted foreigners’ views of many different parts of India.
There is a magnificent series called ‘The India They Saw’ by Meenakshi Jain
Who is a very RW historian in general but this work is top notch
It’s several volumes chronicling accounts of travelers to India in different periods
